questions.prompt: Which command is used to change a configuration option on an application named 'web'?
questions.explanation: 'juju config <app> <key>=<val>' is the standard command for setting application configuration.

questions.prompt: How do you revert a custom configuration setting back to the charm default?
questions.explanation: Passing '--reset <key>' removes user overrides and restores the default value from the charm.

questions.prompt: Which command allows applying multiple configuration values from a YAML file?
questions.explanation: The '--file' flag allows loading key/value pairs from a local YAML file.
